Agency Spotlight

Office of Youth Affairs

Don’t Get Sucked In. Breathe Easy, Vape-Free.
Vaping may seem harmless, but the truth is it can take control before you even realize it. Choose fresh air, healthy lungs, and a future free from addiction.

This Anti-Vaping Awareness Ad is brought to you by the Office of Youth Affairs, in partnership with the Division of Youth Services, CNMI Public School System, and the Commonwealth Healthcare Corporation.

Together, we’re empowering our youth to make healthier choices.
